Done. Here's the summary for Iris:

---

**Exception page per FIN-FPA-04 (Jan–Feb FY26 closed months):**

| ID | Var USD | Var % |
|---|---|---|
| `Engineering_Software_202602` | +16,417.60 | 26.5% |
| `Sales_Travel_202602` | +8,842.30 | 21.6% |
| `Marketing_Training_202602` | +6,342.80 | 28.8% |
| `Operations_Equipment_202601` | +6,912.70 | 20.3% |

**4 items, $38,515.40 total unfavourable.**

No Facilities flags — the cumulative test shows every department well within the full-year budget after January's front-loaded billing. The old January Facilities argument is dead under the v4.1 rule; it's excluded from monthly testing and cumulative actuals are all favourable.

A few near-misses that the policy correctly keeps off the page: Marketing Equipment Feb (+$4.3K, 48% — fails the $5K limb) and HR Training Jan (+$3.1K, 52% — same). Big percentages on small bases, exactly the kind of noise §2 was designed to suppress.
